name: echo-context
title: ECHO Context
description: Search and paste ECHO context from the local daemon.
author: zhenye

commands.name: search-context
commands.title: Search ECHO Context
commands.description: Search recent ECHO context and copy or paste markdown bundles.

commands.name: ask-context
commands.title: Ask ECHO
commands.description: Ask a single-shot question through a local agent connected to ECHO MCP.

preferences.name: customCommand
preferences.title: Custom Command
preferences.description: Used only when Agent is Custom. Supports {question} and {repoPath}.

preferences.name: repoPath
preferences.title: Repository Path
preferences.description: Working directory passed to the agent profile.

preferences.name: claudeOauthToken
preferences.title: Claude OAuth Token
preferences.description: Used only when Agent is Claude. Generate in Terminal with `claude setup-token`. Lets the Raycast-spawned subprocess reuse your Claude subscription without prompting for /login (Raycast cannot access the macOS Keychain item Terminal uses).
